title: Guiding or helping roles in mall world
content: So I suck personally at remembering dream so I can’t say if I have been there but my husband just came across mall world because of TikTok so here I am now lmao now he’s had mall world dreams since he was younger and has explained them to me as well and now finding this whole phenomenon, he’s shooketh lmao So my question here since I’ve seen a few others from google searches - does anyone have any job/task/mission to guide, protect or help others? And I don’t mean in like a tour guide or helper kind of way. I mean like spiritually. In his dream world, he’s like a spiritual detective and you have to help humans or souls find their way when he sees them in his world and they’re asking him for help or they look scared. His world is infested with demons but not everywhere but he has to get them out. It’s very dystopian as well. He has a cabin area where there was a serial killer and that specific cabin that is now haunted by the killers spirit a naval ship and there’s always something happening there (he can never remember but there’s always like a lighthouse style red light that goes off) a mall where he feels lost and wanting to find a toy store and like he’s been there a million times before and when he finds it he goes in a ball pit but it’s deserted (sometimes he has a friend or two with him that are shadowy but they disappear so he doesn’t go to the toy store anymore) a school that always starts off in the basement and there’s a girl there that’s kind of like a vengeful spirit and there’s typically flooding and when he went up the stairs it becomes kind of like tech and you have to wear like VR headsets to navigate a beach with large rocky terrain and huge mountains and tsunami waves and people run away gathering their stuff a hospital that might be connected to the school that’s also deserted with a couple of doctors that can actually save your life and he’s taken the humans/souls that need help as well to heal them. There’s also an asylum but he doesn’t explore it but it’s dark and dreary and abandoned too an apartment complex and each floor has something different and it’s abnormally tall and its glass like one floor is a bunch of office cubicles and another floor is large hallways with stairwells that he could open the door to but the stairs you can go down are spiral and it’s a giant loop
